title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 3/2026 of the European Union for the financial year 2026 – Adjustments in expenditure, update of revenues and other technical updates
part_text: 2. Takes note of the exceptionally high amount of definitive fines and penalty payments included in Draft amending budget No 3/2026; considers that such non-assigned revenue should continue to reduce the GNI-based contributions of the Member States rather than being retained as supplementary revenue for additional Union expenditure; stresses that volatile and unpredictable windfall revenue must not be used to justify permanent expenditure commitments or an expansion of the Union budget;
